span-p01-v01.quick_english: By whose opening closing, of world dissolution emergence — him source of power-wheel glory, Śaṅkara we praise.

span-p01-v02.quick_english: Where abiding this all effect, from which and come forth — from being uncovered-formed, not obstruction is anywhere.

span-p01-v03.quick_english: Waking-etc in difference even, in that undifferent glides forth; turns back from own indeed not, from own being perceiver-ness.

span-p01-v04.quick_english: I happy and suffering and attached and, such awarenesses; strung on pleasure-etc states, they abide elsewhere, they plainly.

span-p01-v05.quick_english: Not suffering, not joy, where not graspable, grasper not and; not and is delusion-state even — that is ultimately.

span-p01-v06.quick_english: Since sense-host this deluded, as if undeluded itself; with inner by wheel, forthgoing standing dissolving.

span-p02-v07.quick_english: Gets by that effort to be examined reality respectfully; since freedom of it, everywhere this unmade.

span-p02-v08.quick_english: Not indeed of wish-impelling this as impeller proceeds; but but from self-power touch, person like that may be.

span-p02-v09.quick_english: Of incapable of own purity, in things to be done of desirous; when agitation may dissolve, then may be supreme state.

span-p02-v10.quick_english: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing-doing-ness; since desired by him all, knows and does.

span-p02-v11.quick_english: Him by presiding state, own nature regarding; smiling as if abides who, his this evil course whence?

span-p02-v12.quick_english: Non-being to be-becomeness goes, not and there is undelusion; since from application contact, then was thus certainty.

span-p02-v13.quick_english: Hence made by that to be known, like deep-sleep state always; not but thus being-remembered-ness, that reality attains.

span-p03-v14.quick_english: State-pair and here, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.

span-p03-v15.quick_english: Facing effect effort which mere, he here is lost; when that lost, utterly lost am thus, unwise holds.

span-p03-v16.quick_english: Not but who inward-facing state, seat of all-knowingness quality; of him loss ever may be, from not perceiving other.

span-p03-v17.quick_english: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may be of fully awake, then at beginning end, of other but.

span-p03-v18.quick_english: Whose form is knowing knowable, by supreme power yoked; in two states pervader shines, elsewhere than that but consciousness-made.

span-p03-v19.quick_english: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda; who got self-getting ever may they be, of knower unopposed.

span-p04-v20.quick_english: Of unawakened minds but these, eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on hard to cross terrible, on wandering road.

span-p04-v21.quick_english: Hence ever striving, for spanda-reality discerning; waking indeed own state, soon attains.

span-p04-v22.quick_english: Very angry, thrilled, or what shall I do thus, or pondering; running indeed which step may go, there spanda established.

span-p04-v23.quick_english: Which state having seized, which this to me will say — that necessarily I will do I, thus having resolved stands.

span-p04-v24.quick_english: Her by resorting to upper path, moon sun both even; in suṣumna set on the path, having left brahma-egg-range.

span-p04-v25.quick_english: Then in that great sky, with moon sun dissolved; like deep-sleep state, deluded awakened may be, uncovered.

span-p01-v01.inference: By opening-closing, worlds dissolve and emerge; to him, source of power-wheel glory — Śaṅkara praised.
premises: By whose opening and closing (the means).
Of worlds dissolution and emergence (the event).
To him, power-wheel-glory source, Śaṅkara — praised (the praise).
span-p01-v01.question: Who is praised?
span-p01-v01.speaker: Devotee (praising)

span-p01-v02.inference: Where this all-effect abides and whence come forth: from being uncovered-formed, no obstruction anywhere.
premises: Where abiding, this all effect (the locus).
From which come forth (the source).
From uncovered-formedness: nowhere obstruction (the openness).
span-p01-v02.question: Where is That?
span-p01-v02.speaker: Teacher (locating)

span-p01-v03.inference: Even in waking-etc. difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never leaves its own being.
premises: Even in waking-etc. difference (the field).
In the undifferent glides forth (the motion).
Perceiver-ness never leaves own being (the staying).
span-p01-v03.question: What glides where?
span-p01-v03.speaker: Teacher (tracing)

span-p01-v04.inference: I-happy, I-suffering, I-attached and the like: those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
premises: I happy, suffering, attached and the like (the claims).
Strung on pleasure-etc. states (their string).
They abide elsewhere, plainly (their place — not here).
span-p01-v04.question: Where do the I-states abide?
span-p01-v04.speaker: Teacher (placing)

span-p01-v05.inference: Where no pleasure, no pain, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion: THAT is, ultimately.
premises: No pleasure, no pain (first negation).
No graspable, no grasper, not even delusion (second negation).
That is ultimately (the affirmation).
span-p01-v05.question: What is ultimately?
span-p01-v05.speaker: Teacher (negating)

span-p01-v06.inference: Since the sense-host deluded thinks itself undeluded: forthgoing, standing, dissolving — by the inner wheel.
premises: Since sense-host deluded as if undeluded (the condition).
Forthgoing, standing, dissolving (the triple act).
By the inner wheel (the instrument — flagged vs 'by the inner wheel' reading).
span-p01-v06.question: How the triple act?
span-p01-v06.speaker: Teacher (mechanizing)
uncertainties: sahāntareṇa cakreṇa parsing open (with-inner by-wheel vs by the inner wheel) — kept literal, flagged for Vṛtti.

span-p02-v07.inference: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
premises: Gets by that effort respectfully (the manner).
To-be-examined reality (the object).
Since freedom of it everywhere unmade (the ground).
span-p02-v07.question: How is reality got?
span-p02-v07.speaker: Teacher (grounding)

span-p02-v08.inference: Not as impelled by wish-impulsion does it proceed; but from self-power's touch the person becomes like that.
premises: Not as impeller of wish-impulsion it proceeds (the denial).
But but from self-power touch (the affirmation).
The person becomes like that (the likeness).
span-p02-v08.question: What impels?
span-p02-v08.speaker: Teacher (denying)

span-p02-v09.inference: When, incapable of own purity and desiring things to be done, agitation dissolves — then the supreme state.
premises: Of the impure, desiring (the bound).
When agitation may dissolve (the condition).
Then supreme state may be (the fruit).
span-p02-v09.question: When supreme state?
span-p02-v09.speaker: Teacher (conditioning)

span-p02-v10.inference: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing-doing-ness; what he desires, he knows and does.
premises: Then his unmade nature (the state).
Marked by knowing-doing-ness (the mark).
Desired by him, knows and does all (the power).
span-p02-v10.question: What is the mark?
span-p02-v10.speaker: Teacher (marking)

span-p02-v11.inference: Regarding own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence his evil course?
premises: Him by presiding state, own nature regarding (the regard).
Smiling as if abides who (the ease).
His evil course whence? (the impossibility).
span-p02-v11.question: Whence evil course?
span-p02-v11.speaker: Teacher (dismissing)

span-p02-v12.inference: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, yet no undelusion there; since contact's application — then thus certainty was.
premises: Non-being to be-becomeness goes (the motion).
Yet no undelusion there (the lack).
Since contact's application, then thus certainty was (the ground).
span-p02-v12.question: What was certain?
span-p02-v12.speaker: Teacher (recalling)

span-p02-v13.inference: Hence that made-thing to be known as ever like deep sleep; but thus being-remembered, that reality does not attain.
premises: Hence made-thing to be known, ever deep-sleep-like (the concession).
But not thus being-remembered (the refusal).
That reality attains not (the exclusion).
span-p02-v13.question: What does reality not attain?
span-p02-v13.speaker: Teacher (excluding)

span-p03-v14.inference: State-pair called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.
premises: State-pair called effect-doer-ness (the naming).
Effect-ness waning there (the waning).
Doer-ness again unwaning (the abiding).
span-p03-v14.question: What wanes, what not?
span-p03-v14.speaker: Teacher (dividing)

span-p03-v15.inference: Mere effort facing effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
premises: Facing-effect mere effort lost here (the loss).
When lost, 'I am utterly lost' (the lament).
So the unwise holds (the error).
span-p03-v15.question: What does the unwise hold?
span-p03-v15.speaker: Teacher (diagnosing)

span-p03-v16.inference: But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever — from not perceiving other.
premises: But who inward-facing state (the turn).
Seat of all-knowingness quality (the seat).
His loss never ever, from not perceiving other (the immunity).
span-p03-v16.question: Whose loss never?
span-p03-v16.speaker: Teacher (excepting)

span-p03-v17.inference: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may be of the fully awake — at beginning-end, but of the other.
premises: His perception ever unfailing in three states (the constancy).
Ever may be of the fully awake (the awake).
At beginning-end, but of the other (the contrast).
span-p03-v17.question: Whose perception ever?
span-p03-v17.speaker: Teacher (contrasting)

span-p03-v18.inference: Whose form is knowing-knowable, by supreme power yoked: in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.
premises: Whose form is knowing-knowable, by supreme power yoked (the yoking).
In two states the pervader shines (the shining).
Elsewhere than that, consciousness-made (the remainder).
span-p03-v18.question: Where does the pervader shine?
span-p03-v18.speaker: Teacher (showing)

span-p03-v19.inference: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
premises: Spanda-flows from common spanda-resting (the source).
Who got self-getting ever (the getters).
May they be, of the unopposed knower (the wish).
span-p03-v19.question: Who may ever be?
span-p03-v19.speaker: Teacher (wishing)

span-p04-v20.inference: Of unawakened minds eager to cover self-standing: they cast down on hard, terrible wandering road.
premises: Of unawakened minds, self-standing-covering-eager (the bound).
They cast down (the casting).
On hard, terrible wandering road (the road).
span-p04-v20.question: Who casts down?
span-p04-v20.speaker: Teacher (warning)

span-p04-v21.inference: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, own state soon attains.
premises: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning (the striving).
Waking indeed own state (the waking).
Soon attains (the fruit).
span-p04-v21.question: What does striving attain?
span-p04-v21.speaker: Teacher (urging)

span-p04-v22.inference: Angry, thrilled, 'what shall I do,' pondering, running — whatever step it takes, there spanda stands.
premises: Angry, thrilled, pondering, running (the states).
Whatever step it takes (the step).
There spanda stands (the standing).
span-p04-v22.question: Where does spanda stand?
span-p04-v22.speaker: Teacher (placing)

span-p04-v23.inference: Which state seized, whatever this tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.
premises: Which state seized, whatever told me (the vow).
That I will do (the doing).
Thus resolved stands (the standing).
span-p04-v23.question: What does he resolve?
span-p04-v23.speaker: Teacher (vowing)

span-p04-v24.inference: Her, by upper path resorting, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range left: thus.
premises: Her by upper path resorting (the resorting).
Moon and sun both in suṣumnā set (the setting).
Brahma-egg-range left (the leaving).
span-p04-v24.question: What is left?
span-p04-v24.speaker: Teacher (ascending)

span-p04-v25.inference: Then in that great sky, moon-sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
premises: Then in that great sky, moon-sun dissolved (the sky).
Like deep-sleep (the likeness).
Deluded, awakened may be uncovered (the opening — first niḥṣyanda's closing word).
span-p04-v25.question: Who may be uncovered?
span-p04-v25.speaker: Teacher (opening)

span-p01-v01.plain_english: By whose opening and closing the worlds dissolve and emerge — to him, source of power-wheel glory, I praise Śaṅkara.
span-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau | taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ

span-p01-v02.plain_english: Where this whole effect abides, and whence it has come forth — from being uncovered in form, there is no obstruction anywhere.
span-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ | tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit

span-p01-v03.plain_english: Even in the difference of waking and the rest, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.
span-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati | nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ

span-p01-v04.plain_english: I happy, suffering, attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
span-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ | sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam

span-p01-v05.plain_english: Where there is no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, and not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately.
span-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca | na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ

span-p01-v06.plain_english: Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.
span-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: yataḥ karaṇavargo 'yaṃ vimūḍho 'mūḍhavat svayam | sahāntareṇa cakreṇa pravṛttisthitisaṃhṛtiḥ

span-p02-v07.plain_english: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
span-p02-v07.sanskrit_cite: labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt | yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā

span-p02-v08.plain_english: Not as impelled by wish-impulsion does it proceed; but, but — from self-power's touch the person becomes like that.
span-p02-v08.sanskrit_cite: na hīcchānodanasyāyam prerakatvena vartate | api tv ātmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet

span-p02-v09.plain_english: Incapable of own purity, desiring things to be done — when agitation dissolves, then may there be the supreme state.
span-p02-v09.sanskrit_cite: nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ | yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam

span-p02-v10.plain_english: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing and doing; whatever he desires, he knows and does.
span-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah | yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca

span-p02-v11.plain_english: Regarding own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence his evil course?
span-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ

span-p02-v12.plain_english: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.
span-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah

span-p02-v13.plain_english: Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not thus being-remembered does that reality attain.
span-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate

span-p03-v14.plain_english: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.
span-p03-v14.sanskrit_cite: avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam | kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam

span-p03-v15.plain_english: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
span-p03-v15.sanskrit_cite: kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate

span-p03-v16.plain_english: But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever, from not perceiving other.
span-p03-v16.sanskrit_cite: na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam | tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt

span-p03-v17.plain_english: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may it be of the fully awake — at beginning and end, but of the other.
span-p03-v17.sanskrit_cite: tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī | nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu

span-p03-v18.plain_english: Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power: in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.
span-p03-v18.sanskrit_cite: jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ

span-p03-v19.plain_english: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
span-p03-v19.sanskrit_cite: guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt | labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ

span-p04-v20.plain_english: Of unawakened minds, eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.
span-p04-v20.sanskrit_cite: aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ | pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani

span-p04-v21.plain_english: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, the own state soon attains.
span-p04-v21.sanskrit_cite: ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye | jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati

span-p04-v22.plain_english: Angry, thrilled, or what shall I do — or pondering, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.
span-p04-v22.sanskrit_cite: atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan | dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ

span-p04-v23.plain_english: Which state seized, whatever this one tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.
span-p04-v23.sanskrit_cite: yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati | tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati

span-p04-v24.plain_english: Her, by resorting to the upper path, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range left.

span-p04-v25.plain_english: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.

essence: Opening-closing: worlds dissolve-emerge; praised power-wheel source.
Where all abides/whence come: uncovered, no obstruction anywhere.
Even in waking-difference: glides undifferent; perceiver never leaves self.
I-happy/suffering/attached awarenesses abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure.
No pleasure/pain/graspable/grasper/delusion: THAT ultimately.
Sense-host deluded-as-undeluded: forthgoing/standing/dissolving by inner wheel.

rasa.justification: Wonder at cosmic opening-closing, the uncovered That, the never-leaving perceiver — settling as negations clear the ground (no pleasure, no grasper, no delusion) into quiescence.

sections.BOUNDARY: No method is given; freedom is stated, not yet reached for.
sections.EXPLANATION: Praise: by whose opening-closing worlds dissolve and emerge — to power-wheel-glory source Śaṅkara, praised. Ground: where all effect abides and whence come forth — from uncovered-formedness, nowhere obstruction. Motion: even in waking-etc. difference, in the undifferent it glides; perceiver-ness never turns back from own being. Elsewhere: I-happy, suffering, attached and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states. Negation: no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately. Mechanism: since the sense-host, deluded as if undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel (parsing kept open).
sections.FUNCTION: Opens with praise and lays the ground: uncovered That, gliding perceiver, elsewhere-states, negated all, wheeled triple act.
sections.KEY TERMS: unmeṣa-nimeṣa (opening-closing — consciousness-eyes, not blinking); anāvṛta (uncovered — the epithet); nirodha (obstruction — nowhere); upalabdhṛtā (perceiver-ness); anyatra (elsewhere — states abide there, not here); paramārthataḥ (ultimately); sahāntareṇa cakreṇa (inner wheel — open).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The ground pledged here — gliding perceiver, elsewhere-states, uncovered That — is worked through freedom, vision, and initiation beyond.
sections.RELATED: Vivaraṇa word-stages (vāk) behind the gliding; Kṣemarāja's Nirṇaya in repo (spanda-ksem.txt) for collation.
sections.SUMMARY: By whose opening-closing worlds dissolve and emerge — praised power-wheel-glory source. Where this all abides and whence come forth: uncovered-formed, nowhere obstructed. essence: By effort reality got respectfully; freedom everywhere unmade.
Not wish-impelled; from self-power touch, person becomes like that.
Impure, desiring: when agitation dissolves, supreme state.
Unmade nature, knowing-doing-marked; desires all, knows and does.
Regarding presiding, smiling as if: whence evil course?
Non-being to be-becomeness; no undelusion; contact-certainty was.
Made-thing like deep-sleep ever; not thus-remembered reality attains.

rasa.justification: Resolve verbs — striving, dissolving agitation, knowing-doing — braced inside quiescence: freedom unmade (not made), action without impeller, unattainment of mere memory. Effort serves stillness.

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is tasted; the fruit's shape is drawn but not entered.
sections.EXPLANATION: Examination: by that effort the to-be-examined reality got respectfully — since freedom everywhere unmade (svatantratā). Denial: not as wish-impelled proceeds; but but from self-power's touch the person becomes like that. Condition: of the impure desiring things — when agitation may dissolve, then supreme state. Mark: then his unmade nature, marked by knowing-doing-ness; all desired, knows and does. Dismissal: regarding own nature as presiding, smiling as if — whence his evil course? Recollection: non-being goes to be-becomeness, yet no undelusion there; since contact's application, then thus certainty was. Exclusion: hence the made-thing to be known as ever deep-sleep-like; but not thus being-remembered does that reality attain.
sections.FUNCTION: Arms the ground with freedom and effort: unmade, un-impelled, dissolved agitation, knowing-doing mark, dismissed evil, refused memory.

sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Freedom and effort pledged here pay out as vision (beholding) and standing (initiation) beyond.
sections.RELATED: Vikalpa-kṣaya (wasting of constructs) thread; suprabuddha returns in v17.

essence: State-pair called; effect wanes, doer unwanes.
Mere facing-effect effort lost; 'utterly lost am I' holds the unwise.
Inward-facing, seat of knowingness: never loss, no other perceived.
Perception ever unfailing triple; fully awake's, beginning-end, but other's.
Knowing-knowable-formed, supreme-yoked: two states shines; elsewhere consciousness-made.
Quality-born spanda-flows from common spanda; self-getters unopposed may be.

rasa.justification: Waning without loss (effect wanes, doer abides), loss without loser (inward never loses), shining without moving (two states, elsewhere consciousness) — stillness in every member.

sections.BOUNDARY: No rite is given; standing is read, not yet directed.

Wish: spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
sections.FUNCTION: Reads standing: what wanes, what is lost, what never loses, what ever perceives, where shines, who may be.

sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The inward exception drawn here becomes the suprabuddha standing and the heart-seed world beyond.

essence: Unawakened coverers cast down on hard terrible road.
Ever striving, discerning spanda-reality; waking attains soon.
Angry/thrilled/pondering/running: whatever step, there spanda stands.
Seized state, promised doing: resolved, stands.
Upper path resorting, moon-sun in suṣumnā; brahma-egg left.
Great sky, moon-sun dissolved; deep-sleep-like: deluded or awake, uncovered.

rasa.justification: Injunctions — strive, seize, resolve, resort, meditate the sky — yet every act lands in stillness: standing, attained, uncovered. The closing anāvṛtaḥ seals the niḥṣyanda where it began (v2).

sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing further is prescribed; uncovered is the last word of the first niḥṣyanda.
sections.EXPLANATION: Warning: of unawakened minds eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on the hard, terrible wandering road. Urging: hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning — waking indeed, own state soon attains. Placing: angry, thrilled, 'what shall I do,' pondering, running — whatever step it takes, there spanda stands. Vowing: which state seized, whatever this tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands. Ascending: her, by upper path resorting, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range (byte-exact .ṅ) left. Opening: then in that great sky, moon-sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered (closing word echoes v2's uncovered).
sections.FUNCTION: Seals the first niḥṣyanda: warns, urges, places, vows, ascends, opens — ending where it began, uncovered.
sections.KEY TERMS: udyukta (striving); pratiṣṭhita (established — wherever the step); saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati (resolved, stands); ūrdhvamārga (upper path); brahmāṇḍa (world-egg — byte-exact .ṅ); anāvṛta (uncovered — closing seal).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The striving pledged in freedom pays out as placed spanda, vowed doing, ascended breath, opened sky.
sections.RELATED: Suṣumnā ascent (cf. saktavijnana raising, distinct system); closing anāvṛtaḥ frames the niḥṣyanda with v2.

notes.craft_notes: FIRST-VERSE VOICE (verdict outstanding — same hand proposed for the whole song-set). Sthāyin: praise-wonder (adbhuta). Sanskrit first: yasyonmeṣa relative + stumaḥ close → L4 keeps invocation arc. Rows: row 1 (Śaṅkara-last). Rupture: dash after rise — praised, then named. Close: end-weight on the name. Minimal pass: 'dissolve and rise' for pralaya-udaya (same). Read aloud: whose? rise — praise. Rejected: 'tremor-lord' — killed: Śaṅkara kept (proper name); 'blink' for unmeṣa — killed: opening kept.

reads_against.argmap: By opening-closing, worlds dissolve and emerge; to him, source of power-wheel glory — Śaṅkara praised.
c1_essence: Opening-closing: worlds dissolve-emerge; praised power-wheel source.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: ground-wonder. Fixed L3 share ('all/issued'). Close: anywhere (negation lands). Rejected: 'veiled' — killed: uncovered kept; 'anyplace' — killed: anywhere plain.

reads_against.argmap: Where this all-effect abides and whence come forth: from being uncovered-formed, no obstruction anywhere.
c1_essence: Where all abides/whence come: uncovered, no obstruction anywhere.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: glide-wonder. Rows: row 3 (even/never frame). Close: being. Rejected: 'drifts' — killed: glides kept; 'Self' capitalized — killed: being kept plain.

reads_against.argmap: Even in waking-etc. difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never leaves its own being.
c1_essence: Even in waking-difference: glides undifferent; perceiver never leaves self.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: elsewhere-joy. Close: sight (plainness). Rejected: 'ego' for ahaṃ — killed: I kept; 'states' flat — 'awarenesses' kept (saṃvit).

reads_against.argmap: I-happy, I-suffering, I-attached and the like: those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
c1_essence: I-happy/suffering/attached awarenesses abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: negation-joy (neti). Close: ground (ultimate lands). Rejected: numbering the negations — killed: list breathes; 'Absolute' — killed: THAT kept.

reads_against.argmap: Where no pleasure, no pain, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion: THAT is, ultimately.
c1_essence: No pleasure/pain/graspable/grasper/delusion: THAT ultimately.

c1_essence: Sense-host deluded-as-undeluded: forthgoing/standing/dissolving by inner wheel.

reads_against.argmap: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
c1_essence: By effort reality got respectfully; freedom everywhere unmade.

reads_against.argmap: Not as impelled by wish-impulsion does it proceed; but from self-power's touch the person becomes like that.
